# plot_maxima { #mofography.visualize.plot_maxima }

`visualize.plot_maxima(dgrid, maxima, ase_atoms, **kwargs)`

It takes in a 3D grid of data, a list of indices of local maxima, and an ASE atoms object, and
returns a plotly scatter3d object with the local maxima plotted as points.

## Parameters

| Name        | Type   | Description                     | Default    |
|-------------|--------|---------------------------------|------------|
| `dgrid`     |        | the density grid                | _required_ |
| `maxima`    |        | the indices of the local maxima | _required_ |
| `ase_atoms` |        | the atoms object from ASE       | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description               |
|--------|---------------------------|
|        | A plotly scatter3d object |
